headline: Trump Administration Grants First Offshore Mining Permits Near American Samoa
summary: The US government granted its first offshore mining licences near American Samoa, covering more than 12.5 hectares. The two licences were awarded to companies whose names have not been disclosed.
why: Deep-sea mining seeks metals such as nickel, cobalt and manganese from the seabed, and new US permits could affect future supply and policy debates on critical minerals.
original_headline: Gobierno de Trump otorga primeros permisos de minería en altamar cerca de Samoa Americana
